## teardownWasm() function

Tear down the WASM instance and free its resources.

Calls `dispose()` on the underlying WASM instance to free linear memory, then clears the module-level reference so [initWasm()](./core.initwasm.md) will reinitialize on the next call.

Primarily useful for test teardown hooks (`afterAll`<!-- -->).

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function teardownWasm(): void;
```
**Returns:**

void
